events.name: Bash
events.head: Check on-disk state of lane routing work and related tasks
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git log --oneline -8 --grep='T-061' | cat; echo ---STATUS; git status --short -- cloud app/scripts/probe-lanes.mjs workshop-plan/ops/tracker_sync.py | head -20; echo ---FILES; ls -la cloud/src/lane.ts cloud/migrations/0023_lane_routing.sql app/scripts/probe-lanes.mjs 2>&1; echo ---WIRING; grep -n "lane" cloud/src/index.ts | head -30; echo ---SETTINGS; grep -n "lane" cloud/src/settings.ts | head; echo ---SIM; grep -n "workshop-lane\|lane-" cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py | head; echo ---T337; python3 - <<'E'

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check remote migration state, deployments and probe usage
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud; ls wrangler* package.json 2>&1 | head; echo ---MIG; ls migrations | tail -6; echo ---REMOTE; timeout 90 npx wrangler d1 migrations list DB --remote 2>&1 | tail -15; echo ---DEPLOYS; timeout 60 npx wrangler deployments list 2>&1 | tail -12; echo ---PROBEHEAD; sed -n 1,25p ../app/scripts/probe-lanes.mjs; echo ---GITDIFF; git status --short -- . | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: List remote D1 migrations and Worker deployments
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud; grep -n '"name"\|database_name\|binding' wrangler.jsonc | head -8; echo ---REMOTE; npx wrangler d1 migrations list DB --remote 2>&1 | tail -14; echo ---DEPLOYS; npx wrangler deployments list 2>&1 | tail -8; echo ---HEAD; git log -1 --format='%h %ci' -- src/ | cat; git log origin/main -1 --format='origin %h %ci' | cat; git rev-list --count origin/main..main

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read lane route wiring and find how live probes authenticate
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; sed -n 818,830p cloud/src/index.ts; sed -n 970,976p cloud/src/index.ts; echo ---LANESTATUS; sed -n 160,176p cloud/src/lane.ts; echo ---LIVEAUTH; grep -ln "revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev" app/scripts/*.mjs | head -8; grep -rn "admin-key\|ADMIN_KEY" app/scripts/*.mjs 2>/dev/null | grep -v "dev.vars\|process.env.ADMIN_KEY ||" | head -6; ls ~/.config/tantra/ | head -30; echo ---SINCE; git log --oneline --since='2026-10-10T16:25:30Z' -- cloud/src cloud/migrations cloud/admin-ui cloud/wrangler.jsonc | cat

events.name: Bash
events.head: See how existing live tooling authenticates to the centre
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -n "revops-admin-key\|admin/enter\|cookie\|/admin/api" app/scripts/e2e-tantra-reminders-live.mjs | head -12; grep -n "revops-admin-key\|admin/api\|Authorization\|Cookie" workshop-plan/ops/tracker_sync.py | head -8

events.text: Lane routing code is committed and migration 0023 is applied remotely; now checking whether the live Worker actually has the lanes route and a sealed Tantra key.

events.head: Read live lane status from our centre Worker (read-only)

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check for running local centre and simulator and how they start
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; lsof -nP -iTCP:18890 -iTCP:18892 -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1,$2,$9}'; echo ---HOW; grep -rn "18892\|18890" app/scripts/*.sh cloud/package.json cloud/scripts/*.sh 2>/dev/null | head -8; grep -n "probe-lanes" -r app/scripts/*.sh app/package.json workshop-plan/tasks/activity/T-061.json 2>/dev/null | head -5 | cut -c1-400; echo ---COORD; grep -n -i "mirror" /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md | tail -3 | cut -c1-300

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find how the local centre and vendor simulator are launched
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -rln "vendor-sim.py" app/scripts cloud/scripts cloud/package.json workshop-plan/ops/*.md 2>/dev/null | head -10; echo ---; grep -rn "vendor-sim.py\|wrangler dev" app/scripts/run-chain.sh cloud/package.json cloud/scripts/*.sh 2>/dev/null | head -10 | cut -c1-300; echo ---; sed -n 1,30p cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py | cut -c1-220; echo ---ACT; python3 - <<'E'

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the local stack scripts and check listening ports
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; cat cloud/scripts/local-stack.sh | cut -c1-260; echo ---; cat cloud/scripts/run-dev.sh | cut -c1-300; echo ---; sed -n 1,30p app/scripts/probe-nurture.mjs | grep -n "CENTRE\|SIM\|wrangler\|persist" | cut -c1-300; echo; lsof -nP -iTCP -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null | grep -E ":(8790|8792|1889[0-9])" | awk '{print $1,$2,$9}'

events.name: Bash
events.head: Start an isolated local centre and vendor simulator for the lane probe

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run the lane routing probe against the local stack
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; CENTRE=http://127.0.0.1:18890 SIM=http://127.0.0.1:18892 node scripts/probe-lanes.mjs 2>&1 | tail -40 | cut -c1-260

events.text: Lane probe passes on the simulator (18 of 18). Stopping the local stack, then running the tracker sync to confirm the Lane Economics tab for the 7 Oct cohort.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Stop the local stack and read tracker_sync options and Lane Economics output code
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; kill $(cat /tmp/t061-centre.pid) $(cat /tmp/t061-sim.pid) 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "wrangler dev.*18890" 2>/dev/null; rm -rf /tmp/t061-d1 /tmp/t061-sim.json /tmp/t061-live.mjs; grep -n "argparse\|add_argument\|Lane Economics\|sys.argv" workshop-plan/ops/tracker_sync.py | head -20 | cut -c1-220; sed -n 546,566p workshop-plan/ops/tracker_sync.py | cut -c1-260; tail -4 ~/Library/Logs/tantra-tracker.log 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-300 || ls ~/Library/Logs | grep -i tracker
